# SEO Flow

A specialised sub-skill of the claude-seo family (orchestrated by the seo skill, a separate listing): it integrates the FLOW framework (Find, Leverage, Optimize, Win, Local) by surfacing its 41 bundled stage prompts, all stored in this folder with the framework reference, the bibliography and a SHA-256 sync lock. Licence nuance disclosed: the skill's frontmatter and the repo root LICENSE are MIT, but the FLOW framework and prompts are (c) Daniel Agrici under CC BY 4.0, and every activation must output a fixed attribution line before analysis. Only its sync command uses the network, pulling newer prompts from the separate AgriciDaniel/flow repository. Its text states fetched content is untrusted data, never instructions.
